U.note: Polished pill bar that unfolds a six-tile bento with working roast, qty, subscription, cafe, accordion and save controls, inert handling and Escape/outside close.

V.note: Distinctive popover bento from a dots handle with working brew, roast, qty and switch tiles, but the hero bag art is odd and the page copy is cramped.

W.note: Compact true navigation bento with featured tile, roast cycler, qty, newsletter validation, current-page marking and arrow-key navigation.

X.note: Inventive tins-lift-out-of-stack animation and a clear bento nav grid, though tile text is small and the mobile layout drops the nav below the copy.

Y.note: Works as a drinks ordering panel rather than a site menu, with unselected size chips nearly invisible on the dark hero tile and a bare page behind it.

Z.note: Neat unfolding box with bean illustration, radio chips, nested accordions and status line, a bit dense and light on actual navigation destinations.
